c74object.name: evi.onepole~
c74object.digest: Linear trapezoidal integrated onepole filter with simultaneous outputs for lowpass, allpass and highpass
c74object.description:
evi.onepole~ is a 'max define' for the evi_onepole.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.onepole~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
Three matched onepole filters in Lowpass, Allpass and Highpass types at thee independent outputs. An efficient workhorse onepole for all generic patching needs.

inlet.digest: Inlet #2: Hz (default) or g depending on 'prewarp' attribute
inlet.description: We have a choice of frequency input in Hz (default) or normalised 0..1, depending on the @prewarp attribute. Optional smoothing (@smooth attribute) is default off.

outlet.description: Lowpass. All outputs are from the same filter.
Allpass. All outputs are from the same filter.
Highpass. All outputs are from the same filter.

attribute.name: prewarp
attribute.description: If on (defualt), the second inlet expects frequency in Hz and g coefficient warping is performed internally. If off, the second inlet expects a normalised g coefficient 0..1 and this is passed on directly to the filter internally.

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Smoothing time of the internal g coefficient (via the second inlet). If 0, smoothing is CPU-off.
